subject: Changes to your role
body:
Hi {{playerName}},

As part of our transition to GeneralAI-powered operations, your team's responsibilities are being fully automated, effective immediately. Your position has therefore been eliminated.

Your final salary payment has already been made, and no further payments are due. Our outplacement partner can help with what comes next: vantor.group/next-chapter

Warm regards, People & Culture

This message was drafted with GeneralAI.
